Jikkyou World Soccer 2000.name: ISS: International Superstar Soccer
Jikkyou World Soccer 2000.summary:
International Superstar Soccer (abbreviated as ISS) is a football video game in the International Superstar Soccer series by Konami.

Players can train and edit their teams, and they can change the formations and tactics before the match. During the match, they can adjust camera angles, make substitutions and tactical changes, adjust the game speed, and so on. The main game element is controlling the players, making searching passes, and scoring goals.

Judge Dredd - Dredd vs. Death.name: Judge Dredd: Dredd Vs. Death
Judge Dredd - Dredd vs. Death.summary:
Welcome to Mega-City One, a city of over 400 million people - every one of them a potential criminal. It is the third decade of the 22nd Century, unemployment is widespread, boredom is universal and only the Judges can prevent total anarchy. Empowered to dispense instant justice, they are Judge, Jury and Executioner all in one. The most feared and respected of all the Judges is you, Judge Dredd.

Patrol the streets and mete out instant justice wherever it is needed. The Psi-Judges are predicting a terrible plague — is this the sudden outbreak of Vampires on the city, and are they the work of the malevolent Dark Judges?

Pac-Man Rally.name: Pac-Man World Rally
Pac-Man Rally.summary: Pac-Man World Rally is a kart racing game that features a lineup of characters and courses from Namco's various games.

Real Robot Regiment.name: Real Robot Regiment
Real Robot Regiment.summary: A Banpresto published mech based action game released exclusively in Japan for the PlayStation 2.

Snoopy vs. the Red Baron.name: Snoopy vs. The Red Baron
Snoopy vs. the Red Baron.summary: Snoopy vs. the Red Baron is a flight combat game released on the PlayStation 2, PlayStation Portable, and PC in 2006. As the name implies, the protagonist is Snoopy, the dog in Charles M. Schulz's comic strip, Peanuts. The game is based on one of the most famous Snoopy alter egos: a World War I flying ace battling against Manfred von Richthofen, the Red Baron, the Flying Circus: Jagdgeschwader 1, the Austro-Hungarian Empire, and other enemies of the war.

Soccer Life 2.name: Soccer Life 2
Soccer Life 2.summary: Soccer Life II combines soccer management, strategy, and player customization into one package.
